title: Mediator's Duty to Disclose Personal, Professional or Financial Interests

content.scenario: A mediator in India is assigned to mediate a consumer dispute. The mediator has a financial interest in the outcome of the dispute, which may affect his independence or impartiality.
content.outcome: The mediator must disclose any personal, professional or financial interest in the outcome of the consumer dispute, as well as the circumstances which may give rise to a justifiable doubt as to his independence or impartiality.

user_queries: What is the mediator's duty in a consumer dispute?
Why must mediators disclose personal interests?
How does a mediator's independence affect the mediation process?
